stage_a_raw:
{
  "decisions": [
    {
      "decision": "serving_domain",
      "evidence": "\"A $10 serving gives you...\" / \"For $4, you'll get...\" (servings are described but never constrained to whole numbers)",
      "options": [
        "NonNegativeReals",
        "NonNegativeIntegers",
        "Binary (0/1 per food)"
      ],
      "plausibility": [
        0.6,
        0.35,
        0.05
      ],
      "majority_option": "NonNegativeReals"
    },
    {
      "decision": "nutrient_constraint_direction",
      "evidence": "\"your daily requirements are 78 grams of protein, 140 grams of carbs, and 1537 calories\" / \"meet these daily requirements\"",
      "options": [
        ">= for protein, carbs, calories",
        "= for protein, carbs, calories",
        ">= for protein and carbs, = for calories"
      ],
      "plausibility": [
        0.85,
        0.1,
        0.05
      ],
      "majority_option": ">= for protein, carbs, calories"
    },
    {
      "decision": "objective_quantity",
      "evidence": "\"meet these daily requirements while keeping your costs to a minimum\" / \"what is the least amount of money you need to spend\"",
      "options": [
        "minimize total cost sum(cost_i * x_i)",
        "minimize number of servings sum(x_i)",
        "minimize cost per calorie"
      ],
      "plausibility": [
        0.95,
        0.03,
        0.02
      ],
      "majority_option": "minimize total cost sum(cost_i * x_i)"
    },
    {
      "decision": "calorie_requirement_treatment",
      "evidence": "\"1537 calories\" listed alongside protein and carbs as a daily requirement",
      "options": [
        "calories as a >= constraint like other nutrients",
        "calories as an = constraint (exact calorie target)",
        "calories omitted (only protein and carbs are 'requirements')"
      ],
      "plausibility": [
        0.8,
        0.15,
        0.05
      ],
      "majority_option": "calories as a >= constraint like other nutrients"
    },
    {
      "decision": "cost_units_interpretation",
      "evidence": "\"For $4, you'll get 14 grams of protein...\" / \"what is the least amount of money you need to spend\"",
      "options": [
        "cost coefficients are dollars per serving, objective in dollars",
        "cost coefficients are cents per serving, objective in cents",
        "costs are per 100g and servings scaled accordingly"
      ],
      "plausibility": [
        0.9,
        0.05,
        0.05
      ],
      "majority_option": "cost coefficients are dollars per serving, objective in dollars"
    },
    {
      "decision": "upper_bounds_on_servings",
      "evidence": "none (no maximum servings or availability limits are stated)",
      "options": [
        "no upper bounds (x_i >= 0 only)",
        "implicit upper bound of 1 serving per food",
        "implicit upper bound from a total-servings cap"
      ],
      "plausibility": [
        0.85,
        0.1,
        0.05
      ],
      "majority_option": "no upper bounds (x_i >= 0 only)"
    }
  ]
}
